state.error: The request could not be completed.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address changed, or the page was removed.

home.lede: A starting point that implements the vue-spa pack as written: layer boundaries, a query key factory, URL state, MSW. One sample domain is the reference implementation for every rule.

fetch.title: One thin fetch wrapper
fetch.body: No axios. `lib/http.ts` only, with cross-origin and cookie auth assumed.

query.title: Server state in the cache
query.body: Pinia holds client state. Server entities are referenced by id.

url.title: Filters live in the URL
url.body: The query params are part of the query key, so cache and address cannot disagree.

msw.title: MSW intercepts in the browser
msw.body: There is no server hop, so the browser is the only place an interceptor can sit.
